visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair and gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a black t-shirt, leans against a black metal railing on an upper floor. Behind him are white social media logos on a black background and a large 'ATDC' sign. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. (2) The camera pans down to reveal a large indoor warehouse filled with various colored cars, including white, blue, and black models. A large banner on the back wall reads '阿慈車庫'. (3) The man stands beside a silver Mercedes-Benz C300. He points to the door, the black interior, the AMG logo on the dashboard, and the C43-style wheels. He then opens the hood to reveal the engine bay, which has some visible dust. (4) Transitioning to a white Ford Focus, the man stands near the driver's side door. He shows the black steering wheel and the dashboard interface briefly before gesturing toward the car's overall exterior profile in the garage. (5) Next, he presents a dark grey Mazda 3. He leans into the open driver's side door and points specifically at the 'BOSE' branding on the door speaker. The lighting is bright and even within the professional garage setting. (6) He moves to a blue Skoda Octavia RS. He gestures to the front of the car and then moves to the rear, opening the hatchback trunk to demonstrate its large, empty cargo capacity. (7) The scene shifts outdoors to a rural road next to green rice fields under a clear sunny sky. The man presents a white Mitsubishi Colt Plus. He gets inside and points at a large aftermarket Android touchscreen installed in the center console.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin over an upbeat, synthetic pop BGM. The voice is bright with a clear broadcasting quality. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition to the garage. (3) As the man presents the Mercedes, a comedic slide whistle SFX plays. His voice modulates frequently to emphasize features like 'AMG' and 'C43'. (4) A mechanical thud sound is heard as he opens and shuts the car hood. An off-screen male voice asks a question with a neutral, curious tone. (5) Transitioning to the next car, a digital 'pop' SFX is heard. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (6) While outdoors, the noise floor increases with a subtle wind texture, but the speaker's voice remains dominant and clear. (7) High-frequency digital UI sounds trigger when the man points at the car's Android screen. The audio ends with a high-pitched comedic vocalization from the presenter.
